title: unify-sdks-auth-retries-streaming-ergonomics-parity-v1.185.0
author: Avery Chen
description: Unify auth/retries and streaming ergonomics across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs; parity fixes and version bumps for v1.185.0. Motivation: customers reported inconsistent retry behavior across SDKs and divergent streaming ergonomics that made feature parity and docs confusing. This PR standardizes auth token refresh and retry backoffs, harmonizes streaming APIs (single unified event model and client-side helpers), fixes a variety of parity gaps found during QA (error typing, metadata propagation, consistent request headers), and bumps SDK package versions. Checklist: - [x] Implement unified auth token wrapper with transparent refresh and automatic 401->refresh->retry flow - [x] Centralize retry policy (idempotency-aware, jittered exponential backoff, circuit-breaker hooks) and expose configurable overrides in all three SDKs - [x] Align streaming surface: unified on_event/on_error/on_close callbacks and a shared lightweight Event object across languages - [x] Add ergonomics helpers: stream_to_text helper in Python, .pipe() convenience in TS, StreamReader abstraction in Go - [x] Parity fixes: consistent error codes, context metadata propagation, header whitelisting - [x] Add integration tests exercising cross-language parity harness and update docs/examples - [x] Version bumps: python v1.185.0, typescript v1.185.0, go v1.185.0 - [x] Update changelogs and release notes for all SDKs. Summary of changes: high-level commit list and file area edits below. CI: initial lint job failed on TS linter rule for callback typing, fixed and re-ran; unit tests had a flaky TS streaming test which was stabilized by introducing deterministic mock timers; integration tests passed against the local parity harness. Merge: squash-merged into main. Notes: kept API surface backwards-compatible where possible; introduced opt-in ergonomics helpers behind feature flags for customers who prefer existing interfaces.
commits: feat(sdk-common): add unified auth token manager + refresh middleware
chore(retries): implement shared retry policy and expose options
feat(python): stream_to_text helper, updated streaming client to new event model
feat(ts): add .pipe() convenience, unify event shape and types
feat(go): StreamReader abstraction, auth middleware integration
fix(parity): propagate request metadata consistently across transports
test(integration): cross-language parity harness and CI workflow
docs: update SDK docs, examples, and changelogs for v1.185.0
review_comments: Diego Martinez: Nice consolidation. Two nits: 1) prefer Context-aware APIs in Go for cancelation, 2) TS typing for Event needs to allow custom metadata. Reply Avery: addressed both; added context param to StreamReader and widened Event generic in TS.
Priya Sharma: Can we expose the backoff parameters via environment var overrides for the hosted clients? Reply Avery: added SDK env var mapping and updated docs example.

Lina Gomez: Integration tests are great; saw flaky TS test earlier. How was flakiness addressed? Reply Avery: replaced real timers with deterministic mock timers in tests and increased stream buffer timeout in CI harness; re-ran and green.
ci_checks: unit-tests: python pass, go pass, typescript flaky->stabilized->pass
release_notes: SDKs: unified auth token refresh and retries, harmonized streaming APIs and ergonomics, parity fixes across Python/TS/Go, bumped SDK versions to v1.185.0. See changelogs for migration notes and opt-in ergonomics flags.
